summary.en: The Chewing Zhuyin input method for Windows added initial Windows on Arm support in v26.11.724.
summary.zh-TW: 新酷音輸入法（Windows 版）於 v26.11.724 起初步支援 Windows on Arm。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: The release notes call the support "initial"; the exact Arm64 installer asset was not visible on the page read.
caveats.zh-TW: 發行說明稱為「初步支援」；所讀頁面未顯示 Arm64 安裝檔的確切名稱。

evidence.title: windows-chewing-tsf releases: v26.11.724 "Windows on Arm 支援"
